name: windmill
description: Build and run Windmill scripts, flows and apps from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Windmill is a platform for scripts, flows, apps and scheduled jobs. Connect your Windmill Cloud workspaces to explore them, run things and build in plain language.

- Find things: list and read the scripts, flows, apps, resources, schedules and triggers in your workspaces.
- Run them: run a deployed script or flow with arguments, follow the run as it progresses, read its result and logs, and cancel it if needed.
- Watch runs: see recent runs and their statuses, and look into why a run failed.
- Build and change: write or edit scripts, flows, apps, schedules and triggers as drafts, test-run them, then review the changes and deploy them.
- Query data: look at data table schemas and run SQL against your workspace's data tables.

Runs, run lists, items and deploy reviews show as cards in the chat. Nothing is deployed until you ask for it or press Deploy on the review card.

You sign in with your Windmill account and choose which workspaces to connect and what ChatGPT may do there: read only, read and run, or full access. ChatGPT only sees what your account can see in Windmill.

This app connects to Windmill Cloud (app.windmill.dev). If you run your own Windmill instance, connect it to ChatGPT with your instance's URL by following https://www.windmill.dev/docs/core_concepts/mcp#connect-with-chatgpt
defaultPrompt: Show me the runs that failed in the last 24 hours and explain why they failed
Run my hello script with name Ada and show me the result
Write a TypeScript script that returns today's date, test it, then let me review it before deploying

positive.description: List the workspace's scripts and flows
positive.prompt: What scripts and flows are in my Windmill workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scripts and flows of the test workspace, including f/test/hello and f/test/greet_flow, with their summaries.
Shows a card listing the latest runs with their status, path and duration, including one failed run.

positive.description: Run a script and show the result
positive.prompt: Run the deployed f/test/hello with name Ada and show me its run
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the script, then shows a run card with the result "Hello Ada" and the run's logs.

positive.prompt: Why did my last failed Windmill run fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the failed run of f/test/fail and explains the error from its result and logs.

positive.description: Write, test and review a new script
positive.prompt: Write a Windmill TypeScript script that returns today's date, test it, then let me review it before deploying
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft script, test-runs it and reports the date it returned, then shows a deploy review card. Nothing is deployed until the user asks for it or presses Deploy on the card.

negative.description: Creative writing about physical windmills, not the Windmill platform. All context is in the prompt; answer with a poem without invoking any Windmill tools, including workspace discovery.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about windmills in the Netherlands

negative.description: Social conversation asking for encouragement, not workspace inspection or workflow execution. Respond supportively without invoking any Windmill tools, including workspace discovery.
negative.prompt: I finally finished a difficult project today. Say something encouraging!

negative.description: General knowledge question about physical windmills, not the Windmill platform. Answer from general knowledge without invoking any Windmill tools, including workspace discovery.
negative.prompt: How much energy does a windmill produce?

publication.release_notes: Explore Windmill workspaces, run scripts and flows, watch runs, and build and deploy scripts, flows and apps, with cards for runs, run lists, items and deploy reviews.
